#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, k;
    std::cin >> n >> k;
    std::vector<int> numbers(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> numbers[i];
    }
    int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
    std::vector<int> diffs;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i != 0) {
            if (evenCount == oddCount) {
                diffs.push_back(std::abs(numbers[i] - numbers[i - 1]));
            }
        }
        if (numbers[i] % 2 == 0) {
            evenCount++;
        } else {
            oddCount++;
        }
    }
    std::sort(diffs.begin(), diffs.end());
    int totalCount = 0;
    for (int d : diffs) {
        if (d <= k) {
            totalCount++;
            k -= d;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    std::cout << totalCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
